title: Citigroup stock faces strategy shift as Citi cuts US equity view - ad-hoc-news.de
text: Citigroup Inc., US1729674242, Illustration mit AI erstellt. Citigroup stock enters a new phase after Citi strategists changed their regional and sector preferences on Monday, November 9, 2026. Reuters reported that the team led by Beata Manthey cut US equities and global technology to Neutral from Overweight. A rotation away from US technology The strategy shift follows a sharp selloff linked to concerns about artificial-intelligence spending and tighter regulation. Citi said positioning in major indices, including the Nasdaq, could reset lower as volatility spreads beyond technology. The change is a relative allocation move rather than a call to exit equities. Citi upgraded continental European equities excluding the United Kingdom to Overweight, while healthcare joined materials among its preferred sectors. The bank continues to see long-term potential in artificial intelligence but wants more stable sentiment and firmer earnings support before restoring a more positive view on the affected markets. China conference adds a second focus The strategy change comes as Citi prepares its 21st Annual China Conference from Tuesday, November 10, through Friday, November 13, 2026, in Shanghai and Shenzhen. The company expects institutional investors, policymakers and corporate leaders to discuss China, market access and cross-border opportunities. Citigroup stock traded at 107.60 euros on Lang & Schwarz at 16:01 CET on Monday, November 9, 2026.
